subject: Coordinating SE technical demo + procurement/security stakeholders
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-11-10T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Intro + scheduling a focused SE demo for Acme infra and security

Hi Lucy —

Thanks for the conversation yesterday. Per our talk, the most valuable next step is a focused technical demo led by our Solutions Engineering (Sergio) that covers:
- deployment options (hosted vs. private VPC)
- network/egress and KMS controls
- performance / batching for your ingest patterns

We expect ~60 minutes: 40m demo + 20m for deep technical Q&A. Can you confirm the right stakeholders? From our notes I have: your lead infra (Maya), security/procurement (Tom). If there are others, please add.

Availability windows that work on our side this week:
- Wed 11/12 10:00–11:15 PT
- Thu 11/13 14:00–15:15 PT
- Fri 11/14 09:00–10:15 PT

I attached a short agenda and a SOC2 excerpt Tom requested. If none of those slots fit, share a couple alternatives and we’ll align. Once we lock a time, Sergio will send a calendar invite with a short pre-demo checklist for access/whitelisting.

Agenda (attached): Agenda_ACME_redwood_demo.pdf
SOC2 summary (attached): redwood_soc2_summary.pdf

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

--
Redwood Inference — production-first LLM inference

Subject: Re: Intro + scheduling a focused SE demo for Acme infra and security

Thanks Marissa —

That looks good. Confirming stakeholders: myself (platform lead), Maya (infra), Tom (procurement/security). We might also include one of our ML infra engineers (Ravi) — I’ll add him to the invite once we lock a time.

Quick notes:
- Procurement needs an abbreviated security walkthrough (SOC2 + VPC details) at the end of the demo, ~15 minutes, and Tom prefers early mornings.
- Maya wants to see startup time for models and an example of prefix caching with a 4k prompt.
- We have an internal network window on Thu 11/13 midday where we can do live connectivity tests; if possible we’d prefer Thu 14:00 PT slot to combine the demo + connectivity check.

Can Sergio lead the live connectivity portion for a few minutes?

Thanks —
Lucy
Lucy Zhang
Lead Cloud Engineer, Acme Industries
lucy.zhang@acme-industries.com

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Lucy Zhang <lucy.zhang@acme-industries.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-11-10T12:28:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Intro + scheduling a focused SE demo for Acme infra and security

Lucy —

Great — Thu 11/13 14:00 PT works for me and I can slot the live connectivity check into the agenda. I’ll plan for the following structure:
1) 10m quick context and goals (Marissa + Lucy)
2) 30m SE demo: architecture, quantization/throughput knobs, demonstration of prefix/KV caching with ~4k prompt
3) 15m live connectivity + small smoke test (networking team assist from Acme)
4) 15m procurement/security Q&A (SOC2 + data residency + keys)

Folks — I need to know: what IP/range we should expect to be allowed for the smoke test, and whether your infra team will be running the test from a bastion or from inside a VPC. If you can share an endpoint and short access window we’ll prepare a tiny test harness — should be <5 minutes.

Attaching the demo agenda and a short Zoom .ics (zoom link will be generated when I create the event).

Attachments: Agenda_ACME_redwood_demo.pdf, redwood-demo-zoom.ics

--
Sergio Alvarez
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai | +1 (650) 555-0199

Marissa / Sergio —

Hi all — quick heads up from procurement/security: Thu 11/13 at 14:00 PT is fine but Tom (me) prefers an earlier start if it’s possible because I have a budget review at 15:30 PT. If the agenda can be tightened to finish Q&A by 15:15 PT that’d be ideal. Also for the SOC2 walk-through I don’t need raw reports, the redwood_soc2_summary.pdf is fine for now.

One ask: can you include an explicit line about data retention defaults (how long logs/inputs are kept) in the agenda? We track that for vendor reviews.

Thanks,
